name: 86hc-hongkong-company
description: Connects to the existing 86hc.com Hong Kong company MCP. Guest quotas apply when no key is set. Filing orders and credit top-ups return payment links.

HK_COMPANY_API_KEY.title: 86HC API key
HK_COMPANY_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave blank for the published guest quota. A key from https://www.86hc.com/user uses the registered quota. Cursor stores the value outside this repository.
